programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Double Trouble Duel, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey each unleash their strongest monster, the Summoned Skull, and the Red-Eyes Black Dragon, but their strength pales in comparison to the tremendous power of the Gate Guardian.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Face Off, Part 1
programme.desc: In order to earn the right to challenge Pegasus, Kaiba must first beat Yugi and take his Star Chips. The rematch between Yugi and Kaiba is about to begin!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Face Off, Part 2
programme.desc: Kaiba summons the Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the strongest monster in the game fused from three Blue-Eyes White Dragons! Yugi has lost all his powerful Duel Monsters, but a true duelist never gives up!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Face Off, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put the Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life. Yugi's heart is split in two!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Shining Friendship
programme.desc: Having lost his star chips to Kaiba and his only opportunity to save Grandpa, Yugi is in a state of shock. Can Tea bring Yugi back to consciousness by defeating Mai for her extra star chips and teach Yugi the heart of the duelist?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Champion vs. Creator, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi and friends enter the castle to discover Kaiba ready to duel Pegasus with Mokuba's soul hanging in the balance! The power of the Millennium Eye gives Pegasus the ability to read other people's minds.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Champion vs. Creator, Part 2
programme.desc: Kaiba is helpless against Pegasus's Toon World deck and mind-reading abilities. As the duel ends, Pegasus imprisons Kaiba's soul into a card, just like Grandpa and Mokuba!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Night Before
programme.desc: Yugi vows to overthrow Pegasus for the sake of his Grandpa. Tristan leads an exploration party to uncover Pegasus's secrets. While Joey sleeps, Bandit Keith steals from him the card that permits his entry in the final battle!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Duel Identity Part, 1
programme.desc: Under Pegasus's glare, Yugi is distracted from his duel with Mai. After making foolish errors and allowing Mai to gain a huge advantage with her Harpie's Pet Dragon, will Yugi gather his focus or succumb to the pressure?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Duel Identity Part, 2
programme.desc: Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Keith's Machinations, Part 1
programme.desc: Joey searches for the card that permits him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it. As he struggles to accept the fact that Serenity will be blind forever, he receives help from a new friend!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: What It Takes To Be Captain!
programme.desc: The Holy Road tournament approaches, a contest that decides which junior high school has the best Football team in the nation. Arion and J.P. watch a video of last year's final match between Raimon and Kirkwood Junior High.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: And the Holy Road Tournament Begins!
programme.desc: With the regional rounds of the Holy Road tournament just days away, the Raimon Eleven are practicing hard. Riccardo has returned to the team, but his determination is shaken when Victor lets him know what the outcome of the first match is to be.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: A Rebellion for Victory!
programme.desc: The first regional round of the Holy Road tournament is underway. In defiance of Fifth Sector's orders, Riccardo scores the first goal against Milky Way Charter School and vows that Raimon will win the match.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Victor’s Secret!
programme.desc: The Raimon Eleven have won the first match of the Holy Road tournament! While Arion is thrilled, others fear the team will be crushed for defying Fifth Sector.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Almighty Faith’s Schools Fighting Spirits!
programme.desc: The instant the match begins, Victor steals the ball and shoots... right into Raimon's own goal! Unless someone else scores, the game will end exactly as Fifth Sector ordered.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Raimon's Football Club Is Rising From The Ashes!?
programme.desc: Determined to destroy Raimon, the Almighty Faith's School players will even risk crippling their opponents. The sight of this triggers an emotional change in Victor.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: J.P.'s Special Move!
programme.desc: The Raimon Eleven, all finally working together as a real team, defeat Almighty Faith School! But Fifth Sector strikes back, using Victor's sick brother to stop his rebellion and blackmail him into obeying once again.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: A Reunion with Jude Sharp!
programme.desc: As Raimon prepares for its scheduled regional semifinal match with Ivy Selective College, they receive startling news: Raimon has been moved to another bracket in the tournament!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: The Dreaded Royal Academy!
programme.desc: The match begins, and Sam just barely manages to block a shot on goal -- Royal Academy is proving to be unlike any other team Raimon has faced.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Explosion Ultimate Thunder!
programme.desc: Raimon attempts a comeback using their super tactic, but end up surrendering a goal to Royal Academy instead. Raimon's offense is powerless in the face of Royal Academy's overwhelming special moves.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Puppet
programme.desc: Roddy McDowall guest stars as Leo Ostro, a brilliant crime syndicate boss who becomes the target of the IMF when he launches a mysterious one-hundred-million-dollar scheme.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Incarnate
programme.desc: Kim Hunter guest stars as Hannah O'Connel a brilliant but superstitious criminal who escapes to a Caribbean country and is drawn into a voodoo ceremony by the IMF to locate a cache of stolen gold she has hidden away.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Boomerang
programme.desc: Laraine Stephens guest stars as the beautiful wife of a crime syndicate boss who becomes the target of both the underworld and the Impossible Missions Force when she has her husband killed and steals his records of the syndicate's operations.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Question

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Fountain
programme.desc: George Maharis guest stars as John Bachman, an underworld figure with access to the syndicate's top secret computerized records who is convinced by the IMF that he has found the fountain of youth.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Siege
programme.desc: Vincent helps the residents of an apartment building defend their homes against thugs who want them out so the land can be re-developed.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: No Way Down
programme.desc: Injured in an explosion, Vincent is captured by a vicious street gang.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Masques
programme.desc: Free to walk the streets openly on Halloween, Vincent becomes the guardian of an Irish peace activist who's been targeted for assassination.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: The Beast Within
programme.desc: Vincent must choose loyalties when a childhood friend becomes a mob enforcer.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Nor Iron Bars a Cage
programme.desc: Accidentally caught on film, Vincent become the target of a scientist desperate to learn the truth about him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Crazy as a Soup Sandwich
programme.desc: A man sells his soul to a demon for some racing tips. After being terrified by the demon he goes for help from the criminal boss he borrowed the track money from

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Special Service
programme.desc: A man finds that his life has been on TV for the past five years

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Showdown with Rance McGrew
programme.desc: Actor Rance McGrew makes TV Westerns for a living, but he's a lousy actor and a worse cowboy. Despite that, each week he "wins" against the bad guys. Finally, the bad guys have had enough and decide to teach McGrew a lesson.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Piano in the House
programme.desc: Fortune discovers that a piano he bought his wife for her birthday has magical properties - the music that it plays makes people reveal their true essence.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Rites of Jeff Myrtlebank
programme.desc: Jeff Myrtlebank comes back to life at his own funeral and soon begins to act very strangely...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Comedian
programme.desc: Comedian Samir Wassan (Kumail Nanjiani) wants to be famous...but at what cost?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 30,000 Feet
programme.desc: Journalist Justin Sanderson (Adam Scott) finds the fate of Flight 1015 in his hands.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Levitation
programme.desc: A teenager enraptured with magicians goes to a flee-bitten circus to seek out one of the greatest ever: Kharma. However, Kharma now does cheap magic for the crowds, and none of the great illusions the teenager believed he was capable of.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: It All Comes Out In The Wash
programme.desc: Carl Gropper, a greedy developer, stumbles upon a Chinese laundry that offers a unique service - it can "wash out" guilt. Carl employs their services but soon finds there is an unpleasant price to pay.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Bigalow'S Last Smoke
programme.desc: Mr. Bigalow, a lifelong cigarette smoker, wakes up to find that his windows have bars on them and his door is sealed shut. A mysterious figure appears on Bigalow's television, informing him that he will quit smoking.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The False Prophet
programme.desc: Cassie Pines is a woman traveling on her own who believes in astrology, tea leaves...e everything. She comes into a diner with a most unusual mechanical fortune teller named Horace X.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Impressionist
programme.desc: An impressionist, "Mr. Personalities," is brought in by the government to try to help them communicate with an alien. Mr. Personalities is at first stumped but finally makes "contact."

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Lifebomb
programme.desc: Ben Martin, a rich businessman, is contacted by a special medical firm, "Lifebomb" which offers him an expensive policy that will let him live forever. They give him an implanted device which, every time he "dies," activates.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Ring Around The Redhead
programme.desc: As Billy is waiting to be executed in the electric chair, he relates the bizarre tale of how he came to be in his predicament at the hands of an attractive woman.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Parlour Floor Front
programme.desc: A woman becomes concerned when she discovers that a man that she and her husband rent a room to has been practicing voodoo. Although the man is good intentioned and kind, the woman regards him as a threatening and undesirable tenant.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Halloween Candy
programme.desc: A mean old man harboring an intense hatred for the celebration of Halloween is left alone by his son to hand out candy to the neighborhood children.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Satanic Piano
programme.desc: Pete Bancroft is a talented pianist who has lost his inspiration, but is contacted by a mysterious inventor who gives him a piano that lets him play as never before simply by thinking of the music. Bancroft is at first relieved.

programme.title: JAG: Tiger, Tiger
programme.desc: Harm takes Josh on a weekend cruise for Navy families aboard a frigate. When the frigate is taken over by terrorists who intend to fire missiles at Cuba, Harm and Bud take matters into their own hands to stop the evil plot.

programme.title: JAG: Return of Mimmy Blackhorse
programme.desc: An Army forensic pathologist joins forces with Harm, Mac, Bud and Harriet as they try to verify that newly unearthed human remains are those of a heroic Navajo "code-talker" who had been missing since WWII.

programme.title: JAG: The Imposter
programme.desc: Harm is held captive by Palmer, a renegade government agent with whom he had crossed swords a few months ago. While Palmer prepares a life mask so he can pass for Harm, he explains his plans to assassinate the key witness in the trial.

programme.title: JAG: To Russia With Love
programme.desc: With evidence that his missing father could still be alive in, Harm convinces the Admiral to give him time off so he can go to Russia. In Moscow, they are questioned by Mark Falcon, the KGB agent who had stolen a list of POW's earlier from Harm.

programme.title: JAG: Gypsy Eyes
programme.desc: Unable to lose the pursuing Russian fighters, Harm's and Mac’s hijacked Mig is shot out of the sky over Siberia.

programme.title: The Love Boat: The Decision / Poor Little Rich Girl / Love Me, Love My Dog
programme.desc: A former waitress, who inherited a fortune, isn't sure if her boyfriend loves her or her money; a man is interested in a woman but her dog doesn't like him; Isaac falls for a woman who's engaged. (TV-PG)

programme.title: The Love Boat: Funny Valentine / The Wallflower / A Home Is Not A Home
programme.desc: Two shy people keep missing each other, due in part to Gopher's interference; two residents of old folks home take a cruise, only to be followed by their meddling children.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Sounds Of Silence / Cyrano De Bricker / Murder On The High Seas

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Three hairs, microscopic fibers, a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lockdown

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sing Sing, Little Bird

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Night Terrors
programme.desc: When Cheryl Brantner’s children find her dead in her bathtub, Lt. Joe Kenda must decide if this was a soapy accident or something worse.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.desc: Henry får uventet besøg af en person, som påstår at komme fra fremtiden. Da en dræbermaskine i form af en drengerobot træder ind på scenen, må de finde en måde at redde alle fra en apokalyptisk fremtid.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Søsterbøvl: Del 1
programme.desc: Pakker bliver stjålet fra Swellviews verandaer. Henry og Ray iværksætter en overvågning for at fange tyven på fersk gerning.

programme.desc: Da Rays hukommelse ved et uheld bliver slettet, udtænker Schwoz en plan, som skal sende Henry dybt ind i Rays hjerne for at få den tilbage.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Mor
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand opfører sig barnligt om det at skulle føde et barn. Fødselsveerne gør ham hjælpeløs, så Faredrengen og Piper må træde til for at stoppe et par fedtede fedttyve.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.desc: Alicia Keys performs Unplugged at the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Placebo MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Placebo unplugged.

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In this MTV Unplugged Special, one of the most extravagant rockstars hits the stage. This is Elton John Unplugged.

programme.title: Lady Gaga & Tony Bennett MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This highly-anticipated episode of MTV Unplugged features Lady Gaga and Tony Bennett performing a combination of stripped-back duets and solo songs from their Grammy-nominated album, Love For Sale.

programme.title: Paul McCartney MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: MTV Unplugged,' world premiered this one hour performance with the legendary Paul McCartney. This performance was simulcast via the Global Satellite Network. Taped on January 25, 1991 at the Limehouse Studios in London.

programme.title: Mando Diao MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Med gæstekunstnere som Ane Brun, Kristofer Greczula og Veera Pyykkö indtager Mando Diao MTV Unplugged-scenen. Pluto TV byder på en intim koncert med Mando Diao og deres nye album "Efter Solnedgången"

programme.title: The Roast of Donald Trump
programme.desc: Milliardæren Donald Trump bliver heglet igennem på Comedy Central af Jeffrey Ross, Seth MacFarlane, Gilbert Gottfried, Whitney Cummings, Snoop Dogg, Larry King, Marlee Matlin, Mike 'The Situation' Sorrentino, Lisa Lampanelli og Anthony Jeselnic.

programme.title: The Roast of Flavor Flav
programme.desc: I hver udgave af 'The Roast of' bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Det er Flavor Flavs tur til at sætte sig i kendissernes varme stol i det nyeste afsnit af The Comedy Central Roast.

programme.title: Another Period: Servant's Disease
programme.desc: En smitsom sygdom spredes blandt tjenestefolkene, og Lilian ender i karantæne med de syge. Beatrice og Frederick går på dobbeltdate, og Victor og Albert skændes over deres barbershop quartet.

programme.title: Another Period: Harvard
programme.desc: Albert Einstein besøger Ballacourt Manor, og Beatrice hjælper ham med at løse en svær ligning. Lillian prøver at skaffe et kondom, så hun kan have sex for nydelse, og Peepers finder Blanches 'fyr' på tosseanstalten.

programme.title: Another Period: Joplin
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrice prøver at skrive et hit med hjælp fra en Kanye-agtig sangskriver ved navn Joplin. Peepers kæmper med sine nyligt opdagede kødelige lyster.

programme.title: Another Period: Tubman
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrice møder Harriet Tubman, der fortæller dem, hvordan de skaber et 'brand' til sig selv og bliver berømte. Imens ansætter Peepers en ny tjener, og Chair føder baby Kermit.

programme.title: Workaholics: Checkpoint Gnarly
programme.desc: Alices bror kommer på forretningsrejse. Anders, Adam og Blake tager ham ud i byen en aften. Det går galt, når de bliver tjekket for sprutkørsel.

programme.title: iCarly: iPære-butikken
programme.desc: Freddies nye drømmejob i Pear Store bliver et mareridt, når Sam også bliver ansat. Imens prøver Carly at blive inviteret ud af en fra Pear Store, og Spencer skal melde sig som frivillig på den lokale brandstation.

programme.title: iCarly: Halvenween
programme.desc: iCarly-slænget holder en "Halfoween"-fest, for de synes, at det skal være Halloween to gange om året. Men da en forklædt gæst snører Carly og vennerne, bliver festen lidt for vild.

programme.title: iCarly: I Kamp med Chip
programme.desc: Et vredt barn ønsker inderligt at hævne sig, men Spencer prøver ihærdigt at stoppe ham. Gibby bliver knust, når hans nye legetøjslaserpistol går i stykker, men bliver himmelhenrykt, når Freddies reparation giver den en overraskende kraft.

programme.title: iCarly: Bandlyst
programme.desc: Da Carly bandlyser T-Bo fra loftet, gør han gengæld ved ikke at lukke Carly ind på Groovy Smoothie. Imens opdager Freddie og Gibby, der er mange fordele ved at være med i et band ... og også et par ulemper.

programme.title: iCarly: Hovedløs i Las Vegas
programme.desc: Da Sam opdager, at hendes mor sidder i fængsel i Las Vegas, beslutter slænget sig for at samle deres mest kostbare ejendele, køre til Vegas og pantsætte deres ting for at få penge til kaution. Gæstestjerner: History Channel's PAWN STARS.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly i knibe
programme.desc: Sams ven kommer ud af ungdomsfængslet, og Sam advarer alle om at holde sig væk, men Carly hører ikke efter og kommer ud på dybt vand. I loftet finder Spencer et par briller med natkikkert.

programme.title: iCarly: Bukseskandalen
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-slænget til at optræde live på sit program i New York. De elsker New York og er vildt glade for at være med i programmet, men alt kan ske i live tv.

programme.title: iCarly: Bukseskandalen (del 2)
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-slænget til at optræde live på sit program i New York, men en stor garderobefejl fra Gibby betyder store problemer for netshowets fremtid.

programme.title: iCarly: Spencers nye venner
programme.desc: iCarly-slænget vil finde venner til Spencer på hans egen alder. De finder nogle gode muligheder, men vil venskaber blomstre?

programme.title: iCarly: Stop tyven!
programme.desc: Da Sams bærbare bliver stjålet, prøver iCarly-slænget at hjælpe hende med at opspore tyven. Imens må Spencer ikke besøge sin yndlingsspillehal, hvis han ikke er i følgeskab med et barn. Hans held vender, når Guppy har brug for en babysitter.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama College Years
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan befinder sig pludselig i en genopførsel af Borgerkrigen, Jesus møder en farlig alfons, og vi får set præsident Barack Obama de første år på college.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor
programme.desc: En kildeleg mellem to venner bliver mærkelig, forfattere brainstormer til 'Gremlins 2', to bøller mistænker deres ven for at stjæle og Keegan og Jorden diskuterer Afrika til en fest.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Soul Food
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan diskuterer, hvem der er mest sort og når man er den eneste sorte fyr til en fest. Sketches inkluderer Tea Party, der opdager et nyt håb, hærens hververe, der tænker anderledes, og Bobby McFerrin, der dyster mod Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Branding
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan udforsker oplevelsen som sort collegestuderende og snyltegæster, som succes medfører. Andre sketches inkluderer et kvartes reaktion på et mystisk væsen, hvornår man kan - og ikke kan - sige et kontroversielt ord.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Manly Tears
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en narkohandel, der går galt, en mafiafyr, der er en stor tudemarie, og Darius Rucker, der prøver at håndterer sin Hootie-fortid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meegan & Andre Break Up
programme.desc: To venner kommer i klammeri på en klub, Meegan og André har en seriøs samtale, en rapper går fra et interview, Conrad flyver business class og Keegan har et nyt overskæg.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Old Ladies And Satan
programme.desc: To gamle damer slås mod Satan, ting går galt når en mand vil købe en ny madras og gæsterne på en klub tvinges til at se sandheden om sig selv.

programme.title: Key & Peele: A Cappella Club
programme.desc: En PSA arbejder med børnesoldater i Afrika, en college-a-cappella-gruppe får et nyt medlem, Meegan og André går på deres første date, en terrorgruppe har en foodtruck og to gamle mænd diskuterer popmusik.

programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean travel to Knutsford, Cheshire and visit the Legh Arms.

programme.desc: A 16th Century pub that has a haunted history. The duo come into direct contact with spirits haunting the location. Even during the day there is no shortage of ghostly activity, on this lock down special paranormal Ghost Dimension investigation.

programme.desc: Sean heads to Oswestry to investigate claims of hauntings at a castle thousands of years old, and believed to be haunted by an angry judge. Will any of the souls that departed here come out to play?

programme.desc: Sean continues his investigation of the castle and attempts to make contact with the spirit world. It appears he is not alone.

programme.desc: Sean continues his investigation at Leeds Library and attempts to communicate with a spirit known by the name of Sternberg. Will his investigation have a happy ending?

programme.title: Sæson 21: Episode 2127
programme.desc: Et følelsesmæssigt svært valg skal træffes på hotellet i dag, og det bliver en tårevædet omgang, når der skal siges farvel til én af hotellets mest elskede gæster.

programme.title: Sæson 21: Episode 2128
programme.desc: Der er Halloweenfest på hotellet, og især én af fyrene er særligt ombejlet i aften. Og så indhenter fortiden én af gæsterne, da en ny pige ankommer til hotellet.

programme.title: Sæson 21: Episode 2129
programme.desc: En usikker parceremoni venter for pigerne, og talegaverne skal være i orden for at kunne overleve. Men det er ikke altid, det, der bliver sagt, er sandheden, og for én gæst bliver det meget tydeligt.

programme.title: Sæson 21: Episode 2130
programme.desc: Endnu en fest løber af stablen på hotellet, men ikke alle kan nyde den fuldt ud. Og så får to gæster en mulighed for at sætte andre i fare, men det kræver gode overtalelsesevner.

programme.title: Sæson 21: Episode 2131
programme.desc: En pludselig afstemning skaber forvirring på hotellet. Og så er det tid til at få nogle sandheder på bordet, når der er Pandoras Æske. Og der bliver ikke lagt fingre imellem.

programme.title: Sæson 21: Episode 2132
programme.desc: Der bliver spillet højt spil ved aftenens Parceremoni. Og så lader det til, at spillet er steget én af gæsterne til hovedet. Og det sætter unødigt spotlys på ham.

programme.title: Sæson 21: Episode 2133
programme.desc: Billeder af tidligere gæster står linet op i Palapaen, og så går gætterierne ellers i gang. For hvem mon kommer ind igen? Og så får følelserne frit løb til aftenens fest.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2306
programme.desc: Mikkel er asfaltørelev, så når han ikke er i skole, bor han hos sin kæreste, Steffanie. Men Mikkel betaler ikke husleje, så Steffanie står med hele regningen.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2301
programme.desc: I Helsinge bor 23-årige Nicolai som er ludoman. Hans afhængighed er så alvorlig, at han har spillet sin lejlighed væk, så nu bor han i en lille campingvogn, som han låner af en ven.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 105
programme.desc: Zennie Østerlin og Uffe Larsen bruger årligt over 100.000 kroner mere, end de tjener. Det unge par bor i Ålborg, hvor Zennie er studerende, og Uffe arbejder som salgsassistent.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1012
programme.desc: 34-årige Leif og Julie på 33 har boet i eget hus i Lundby siden 2007, hvor de lånte til både hus og istandsættelse. Nu føler de at pengene forsvinder mellem fingrene på dem, og hver måned er en kamp for at afbetale på deres mange lån.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1803
programme.desc: I Rødovre går arbejdsløse Trine rundt og har ondt af sig selv efter en skilsmisse. Hun har nemlig ikke overblik over sin økonomi, sådan som hendes ekskone havde det, og nu skal hun vende hver en krone.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1208
programme.desc: Luksusfældens eksperter har haft umådeligt svært ved at trænge igennem til Amalie Szigethys økonomiske fornuft. Amalie er end ikke blevet overbevist om at det er en god ide at betale skat.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark - Ny sæson!
programme.desc: Kærlighedshulen – Hide Away – åbner for første gang for et heldigt par. Den hemmelige romance mellem Thomas og Alberte vokser og Thomas indfører overordnet ærlighed over for Melanie.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark - Ny sæson!
programme.desc: Melanie har en mistanke om, at Thomas ikke er helt ærlig, og Thomas må igen prøve at overbevise hende om trofasthed. Den nye fyr forarger pigerne med meninger om buttede pigers chance hos ham.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark - Ny sæson!
programme.desc: En hemmelig romance ser dagens lys – Og afsløringen medfører tårer og fortvivlelse i villaen. Og så spidser trekantsdramaet til hos Amalie Maria, Kasper og Jonas.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark - Ny sæson!
programme.desc: Der er stærke følelser på spil, når både romancer og bromancer blomster, men når en OG’er må forlade villaen, bryder selv de mest hårdføre sammen.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark - Ny sæson!
programme.desc: Ligesom roen er ved at sænke sig over villaen ankommer en bombe af en ny fyr, der gør alle pigerne fjantede og de gamle drenge nervøse - med go’ grund.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark - Ny sæson!
programme.desc: Efter 20 minutter i villaen ser Rayan sit snit til i al hemmelighed at kysse med både Alberte og Camilla. Wingman Nicolaj opdaterer Jonas ned til allermindste detalje og Jonas er IKKE begejstret.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark - Ny sæson!
programme.desc: Der er overskud af piger, så Camilla og Dina lægger en snedig hemmelig plan få at smidt uønskede elementer ud. Og så kommer der max liv i hideaway, da Liv og Nicolaj får en nat i hinandens selskab.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 811

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1013
programme.desc: Mopper har igennem årene har givet os mange dejlige, farvestrålende og sjove stunder. Vi har samlet et udklip af favoritterne, her hvor vi hylder hele Danmarks Mopper.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1107
programme.desc: Tina render igen rendt ind i uheld, da familiens nye hjem bliver udsat for indbrud. Amalie og Karina er taget på holistisk retreat for at give slip på dårlige energier.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Janni og Karsten skal have opereret deres elskede hund Lola. Janni er meget nervøs for indgrebet – især da hun opdager, hvor ung dyrelægen er.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Hos Forsidefruerne er der røre i andedammen da Gunnvør og Oliver Bjerrehus vælger at annoncere en stor nyhed på Instagram.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Der fuld gang i den hos de travle Forsidefruer. Gunnvør og kæresten Oliver Bjerrehus skal til 3D scanning for at finde ud af om de venter sig en dreng eller pige.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Attic and 'Til Death

programme.title: Apollo 18

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: En deltager skriger i smerte, mens det i Dysten bliver det afgjort, om det er enten Trine og Dennis eller Sanne og Maria, der risikerer at ryge ud. En af dem bliver den første, der bliver stemt ud.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Jakob Kjeldbjerg åbner Robinson Ekspeditionen med et benhårdt opgør. To vindere står tilbage med stor indflydelse på fordelingen af årets to hold. Fire tabere sendes direkte på Tabernes Ø.

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 201

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Keith's Machinations, Part 1
programme.desc: Joey searches for the card that permits him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it. As he struggles to accept the fact that Serenity will be blind forever, he receives help from a new friend!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Keith's Machinations, Part 2
programme.desc: After Bandit Keith's Machine deck forces Joey to take the defensive, Joey mimics Keith's battle strategy to metalize his Red-Eyes Black Dragon! Is victory assured, or does the cheater Bandit Keith literally have one last card up his sleeve?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 1
programme.desc: Joey challenges Yugi for the right to face Pegasus. In a battle between friends, a fierce match ensues between the two people who know each other's strategies and cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi is shocked as Joey uses the Time Wizard card on him. It's the very same card Yugi gave Joey as a sign of friendship!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi prepares for the ultimate battle against Pegasus with the souls of Grandpa, Kaiba, and Mokuba on the line.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi's monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi's soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus's mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus's Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi crumples under the power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi's chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 5
programme.desc: Pegasus summons Relinquished, a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi's Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with… Kuriboh?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Aftermath
programme.desc: Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi's mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Wrath of Rebecca
programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Explosion Ultimate Thunder!
programme.desc: Raimon attempts a comeback using their super tactic, but end up surrendering a goal to Royal Academy instead. Raimon's offense is powerless in the face of Royal Academy's overwhelming special moves.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: A Revolutionary Wind!
programme.desc: The day after their blistering battle in the regional semifinals, the Raimon players are ordered to meet at Royal Academy. There, they learn the stunning truth behind their match with the academy.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Ravaging Fangs of the Sea Kings!
programme.desc: Determined to free Football from the clutches of Fifth Sector, the Raimon Eleven prepare to revolt. With the regional championship against Pirates Cove Merchant Marine Academy Academy coming up, morale is high, and losing is not an option.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Fly Arion’s Fighting Spirit
programme.desc: The true revolution won't occur until the crowds watching are reminded of the power of real Football and decide to take a stand. The Raimon Eleven welcome back members who had quit, and the regional championship match begins.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: The Autumn Sky Challengers!
programme.desc: The Holy Road tournament is finally underway. Surrounded by powerful enemies sent by Fifth Sector, the matches ahead will be the toughest yet. So the team practices harder than ever, reminding themselves that no opponent is unbeatable.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Gather, At The Flag Of Revolution
programme.desc: After seeing the newcomer's strange behavior in a practice match with the residents of ''Windsor Manor' flats, Bagriel Garcia (Gabi) begins to suspect the boy may be a Seed agent sent by Fifth Sector.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: The Fearsome Cyclone Arena
programme.desc: The first round of the Holy Road tournament gets underway at Aerodrome Arena. The Raimon Eleven are put on the defensive by Lunar Sea (Military) Academy's formations and attacks, which take full advantage of special contraptions unique to the venue.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Revive Our Football!
programme.desc: Raimon uses Aitor and Gabi's stellar tandem skills to combat Lunar Sea's tactical play. When Arion uses his Fighting Spirit to even the score, momentum shifts to Raimon.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: He’s back!
programme.desc: Following in Aitor's footsteps, a new player tries out for Raimon. Coaches Evans and Sharp see his love for the game and readily accept him, and despite having only two months experience, he quickly integrates himself with the team.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: The Adversarial White Devil
programme.desc: Alpine has fallen under the control of Fifth Sector, and Raimon is tasked with rescuing them. Knowing that Alpine's stout defence can stand up against Thunderbolt, Raimon prepares a surprising new tactical play.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Fountain
programme.desc: George Maharis guest stars as John Bachman, an underworld figure with access to the syndicate's top secret computerized records who is convinced by the IMF that he has found the fountain of youth.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Fighter
programme.desc: William Windom guest stars as Paul Mitchell, a boxing promoter tied to a crime syndicate who becomes a target of the IMF when one of his fighters is killed before he can talk to the police.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Speed
programme.desc: A breathtaking motorcycle chase over the hills of San Francisco figures prominently in the IMF's plan to recover three tons of the drug commonly known as speed from Sam Hibbing's illegal drug operation.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Pendulum
programme.desc: Dean Stockwell guest stars as Gunnar Malstrom, one of the leaders of Pendulum -- a secret terrorist organization -- who has a plan involving a major attack on the government that the Impossible Missions Force is assigned to uncover.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Western
programme.desc: Ed Nelson guest stars as Van Cleve, a brilliant thief who is convinced by the IMF that he has the power of precognition as part of its plan to recover the more than five million dollars worth of art treasures that he has stolen.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Nor Iron Bars a Cage
programme.desc: Accidentally caught on film, Vincent become the target of a scientist desperate to learn the truth about him.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Song of Orpheus
programme.desc: When Father ventures to the Above World for the first time in decades, he is arrested for murder. Vincent and Catherine must delve into Father's mysterious past to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Dark Spirit
programme.desc: Investigating a mysterious death makes Catherine the target of a voodoo cult.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: A Children's Story
programme.desc: Catherine learns that the city's model foster home for children is hiding a dark secret.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: An Impossible Silence
programme.desc: When she witnesses a shooting, a deaf girl must decide whether to abandon the sanctuary of the City Below to free an innocent man.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 30,000 Feet
programme.desc: Journalist Justin Sanderson (Adam Scott) finds the fate of Flight 1015 in his hands.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: To Serve Man
programme.desc: The Kanamits, 9-foot tall aliens, arrive on Earth with one lofty goal: To Serve Man.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Little Girl Lost
programme.desc: Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Fugitive
programme.desc: Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Person or Persons Unknown
programme.desc: David Gurney wakes up to find that no one - his wife, his co-workers, his best friend, not even his own mother knows him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Replay
programme.desc: Nina (Sanaa Lathan)'s old camcorder can rewind time, but can it help her ensure the future of her college-bound son Dorian (Damson Idris)? Glenn Fleshler and Steve Harris guest star.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Traveler
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve in Iglaak, Alaska, a mysterious traveler (Steven Yeun) wishes to be pardoned by Captain Lane Pendleton (Greg Kinnear).

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Satanic Piano
programme.desc: Pete Bancroft is a talented pianist who has lost his inspiration, but is contacted by a mysterious inventor who gives him a piano that lets him play as never before simply by thinking of the music. Bancroft is at first relieved.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Devil'S Advocate
programme.desc: A hate-style radio host, Mandrake, spews out venom at anyone who calls in. He soon discovers, however, after receiving calls across all of time that he is dead but that the "Boss," has kept him on.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Distant Signals
programme.desc: Lingerie salesman Chester Caruso checks into a budget motel and makes a pass at a woman who is also checking in. She rejects him, but soon he wakes up in his room to find a different woman, dressed in lingerie, calling him Harry.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Trouble With Mary Jane
programme.desc: Two occultists are offered $50,000 if they can rid a girl of the multiple demons possessing her, but they soon find themselves in over their heads.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Ursa Minor
programme.desc: When Joan finds a new teddy bear in her daughter's room no one seems to know where it came from. Then night after night huge claw marks are found on the walls and the sounds of something very large can be heard moving through the house.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Effect And Cause
programme.desc: An artist named Kate discovers that she under unknown circumstances, has the psychic ability to live backwards, but things soon turn out for the worse when she realizes it's beyond her control.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Monsters In My Room
programme.desc: A little boy named Timmy tries to convince his mother and mean stepfather, that there are horrific creatures in his room, which includes a tentacled monster under his bed, a boogeyman, a saw, and a witch.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Comet Watch
programme.desc: Englebert Ames, an astronomer, is watching Hailey's Comet and is in for a shock when Sir Edmond Hailey himself arrives - he's been riding "his" comet all these years trying to elude Sarah, the woman pursuing him out of obsessed love.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Dream Girl
programme.desc: A group of people find themselves trapped in a scenario with Otto, only to discover that he is a stagehand and they are a theater group all trapped in his dream.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: A New Lease On Life
programme.desc: A man is overjoyed to find a nice apartment with all the modern conveniences at an incredibly cheap price. The eccentric landlady asks nothing more than for the man to provide her with plenty of garbage for the disposal unit.

programme.title: JAG: Gypsy Eyes
programme.desc: Unable to lose the pursuing Russian fighters, Harm's and Mac’s hijacked Mig is shot out of the sky over Siberia.

programme.title: JAG: Act of Terror
programme.desc: When Arab terrorists attach a mine to a US Navy warship in an attempt to sink it, Marine guards are able to kill one and capture the other, even after the mine explodes, killing two sailors.

programme.title: JAG: The Black Jet
programme.desc: Harm and Mac are sent to Teheran, Iran to represent a Navy flier whose Stealth jet crashed in Iran due to a major mechanical failure.

programme.title: JAG: Silent Service
programme.desc: Mac and Harm are having trouble relating...a result of working together under stress for so long.

programme.title: JAG: King of the Greenie Board
programme.desc: Harm is now a Tomcat division commander aboard the carrier USS Patrick Henry that is patrolling the Mediterranean near Yugoslavia.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Super Mom / I'll See You Again / April's Return
programme.desc: One-time stowaway April Lopez returns to the ship as a popular singer. However, she grows tired of the hassles of fame and decides that she would like to become a cruise director.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Third Wheel / Grandmother's Day / Second String Mom
programme.desc: Gopher gives his parents a cruise as a Mother's Day present. Gopher's father grows jealous of the close relationship between mother and son.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Carol & Doug’s Story, Part 1
programme.desc: Julie catches love fever on the high seas and is thinking of marriage when the Pacific Princess is chartered for a dazzling star-studded wedding cruise that takes Capt. Stubing, his crew, and their guests on a beautiful scenic journey to Alaska.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Carol & Doug’s Story, Part 2
programme.desc: Wealthy Alaskan Buddy Bowers (Lorne Greene) recruits the services of the ship to take the wedding party from Vancouver, B.C., to Skagway, Alaska, for the nuptial ceremonies for his orphaned granddaughter, Carol (Lisa Hartman).

programme.title: The Love Boat: Going My Way / Dance With Me / Doc, Be Patient
programme.desc: When Doc (Bernie Kopell) gets the flu, he receives private treatment from a gorgeous doctor (Susan Sullivan) who keeps his fever up even when his temperature drops.

programme.title: Wings: Take My Life, Please
programme.desc: Helen takes a stab at stand-up comedy.

programme.title: Wings: Four Dates That Will Live In Infamy
programme.desc: Helen, Brian, Joe, and Lowell, desperately seeking dates, join a video dating service.

programme.title: Wings: The Bank Dick
programme.desc: Brian becomes a bank security officer.

programme.title: Wings: Say It Ain't So Joe
programme.desc: Joe is crushed when he learns that his old high school baseball strikeout record is in jeopardy.

programme.title: Wings: Duet For Cello And Plane
programme.desc: Joe finds himself playing second fiddle to Helen's cello when she decides to pursue her music career full-time.

programme.title: Wings: Lifeboat
programme.desc: In this conclusion to last season's cliffhanger, Joe, Brian, Helen, Lowell, Fay and Roy find themselves struggling for survival in a leaky lifeboat after their plane goes down over open waters in route to Helen' s debut with the Boston Philharmonic.

programme.title: Wings: The Fortune Cookie
programme.desc: The future of Sandpiper Air may be permanently grounded when Joe's insurance company refuses to pay for the damage caused by his recent plane crash into the ocean.

programme.title: Wings: Noses Off
programme.desc: Joe gets a punch in the nose, but it's Brian's ego that gets bruised in this timely episode on male plastic surgery. After a jealous boyfriend mistakes Joe for Brian and hits him, a remorseful Brian takes Joe to the best plastic surgeon in Nantucket.

programme.title: Wings: Blackout Buggins
programme.desc: Roy sees red, white and blue when she hears a rap artist sing a non-conventional version of the National Anthem at a baseball game. On a dare, he agrees to belt out his own rendition at a Red Sox game.

programme.title: Happy Days: Bye Bye Blackball
programme.desc: Richie, Ralph, and Potsie endure the harassment of "hell week" to prove themselves worthy to enter their college fraternity, Phi Kappa Nu.

programme.title: Happy Days: Joanie's First Kiss
programme.desc: Sophomore Joanie Cunningham gets basic back-seat defense tips from Richie and Fonzie before her first "car date" with a senior boy, and then cramps her older brother's style when she and her date show up at his college "make-out" party.

programme.title: Happy Days: Richie Almost Dies
programme.desc: What begins as a humorous escapade with a motorcycle turns into a tragic vigil for the Cunninghams and their friends.

programme.title: Happy Days: Do You Want to Dance
programme.desc: Fonzie's latest romantic interest, a ballet teacher, is secretly yearning to turn professional and dance with the greats in New York. Fonzie, however, has trouble accepting that she may forgo their relationship to pursue her dreams of fame.

programme.title: Happy Days: Fearless Malph
programme.desc: When Ralph Malph is hypnotized to cure his fright after a tornado warning is posted, Ralph's loss of fear causes him to tempt fate by suggesting that the Fonz needs training wheels for his stupid motorcycle

programme.title: Happy Days: Smokin' Ain'T Cool
programme.desc: Joanie believes she has to smoke to fit in with the cool girls. She ignores the pleas from her family to stop, until the Fonz defines what cool really means

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonzie's Blindness
programme.desc: In a poignant, change-of-pace episode titled Fonzie's Blindness, Al barges through the kitchen door at the drive-in and hits Fonzie in the head with a tray of food.

programme.title: Happy Days: Casanova Cunningham
programme.desc: When Richie is caught two-timing Lori Beth for a pretty baton twirler, the Fonz has to step in and give Richie a few lessons in love.

programme.title: Happy Days: Richie Gets Framed
programme.desc: Richie and the Fonz visit a massage parlor to escape the pressures of a heated class presidency race, and Richie's opposition photographs the sheet-clad candidate with a pretty masseuse.

programme.title: MacGyver: There But For The Grace

programme.title: MacGyver: Bind Faith

programme.title: MacGyver: Faith, Hope & Charity
programme.desc: MacGyver is drawn into a mobster's search for stolen loot while nursing his injured leg at a country bed and breakfast run by two elderly sisters.

programme.title: MacGyver: Strictly Business
programme.desc: Murdoc is ordered to kill MacGyver in order to prove his loyalty to a professional hit squad.

programme.title: MacGyver: Trail of Tears

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets

programme.desc: After thousands of hours of painstaking preparation and dangerous flying, a terrible accident devastates the waterbomber crew in Turkey - and everyone at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Target Practice
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey head to England to bring home a new plane. Devan does target-practice in the DC-4.James builds a Buffalo-style soapbox racer.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Arnie Calls It
programme.desc: While training waterbomber captains for the upcoming fire-fighting season, Chief Pilot Arnie makes a surprising decision. AJ becomes a DC-4 captain and ponders whether to accept a promotion.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Second Chances
programme.desc: Rookie pilot Jeff nearly runs off the runway. Prefkar learns to play hockey but drops the ball at Buffalo and Joe goes on a date with a real dog.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Over the Edge
programme.desc: A report on the investigation into the 2009 disappearance of Dawn Viens, and why her husband, California chef David Viens, jumped off a cliff when he became a suspect in her disappearance.

programme.title: 48 Hours: My Father's Killer
programme.desc: James Bernard Campbell entered SueZann Bosler's home, murdered her father and almost killed her. 48 HOURS follows SueZann as she returns to the crime scene and then focuses on her unusual crusade for justice.

programme.title: 48 Hours: An Invisible Enemy
programme.desc: It was February 2002 when Cynthia Sommer, her husband, Marine Sgt. Todd Sommer, and their four children were coming home from a family weekend at an amusement park.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Millionaire, The Model, and The Hit-man
programme.desc: An investigation into the relationship between Dino Guglielmelli, a millionaire health supplement distributor, his model wife, Monica Olsen, his business partner Richard Fuhrmann, and the $80,000 "hit" Guglielmelli ordered on his wife.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Letter
programme.desc: In 1998, police in Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin were called to the home of Mark and Julie Jensen. Mark said he had found his wife dead in her bed. But a letter written by Julie before her death expressed her suspicion that Mark might kill her.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Prisoners in Paradise
programme.desc: When Lois McMillen, a Connecticut artist was found dead on the British Virgin Island of Tortola in January 2000, four young American tourists were charged with her brutal murder.

programme.title: COPS: Gimme a Break
programme.desc: Officers pursue two brothers after an attempted bank robbery. A confused man with a shotgun calls police after hearing voices. Deputies find illegal items in the back of a man's truck.

programme.title: COPS: Table for Two
programme.desc: Police respond to an emergency call and find a man in dire trouble. Deputies respond to an abusive husband at a local eatery. Two women try to buy narcotics from an undercover deputy during a sting.

programme.title: COPS: Candlelight Burglar
programme.desc: Deputies respond to a fight between a daughter's boyfriend and her mother. A woman lights candles after an attempted break-in. Police respond when an evicted tenant tries to reenter his old apartment.

programme.title: COPS: The Car is Mine!
programme.desc: A man locks himself in a trunk after deputies respond to a restraining order call. Deputies respond to two women arguing over the ownership of a car.

programme.title: COPS: Bike for Sale
programme.desc: A deputy pursues a man who fled from a traffic stop. A deputy chases a suspicious man leaving an apartment complex. Two men claim they are trying sell a bike during a traffic stop.

programme.title: COPS: She Needed a Nap
programme.desc: Deputies pursue a man involved in a carjacking. Deputies are called to an altercation between a father and son. Officers respond to an unresponsive woman lying in a roadway.

programme.title: COPS: Mamma's House
programme.desc: Deputies search for a man who ran from a traffic stop. A man being pursued tells officers he was going to his mother's house. A drunk driver won't admit to hitting a car.

programme.title: COPS: Mean Girls Times Two
programme.desc: Deputies are forced to taser a man after pursuing him into a field. A driver plays dumb when asked about the revolver under his car seat. Officers respond to two teenage girls in a fight.

programme.title: COPS: Backseat Denial
programme.desc: An officer struggles with a man reaching for something in his pocket. A man won't cop to the gun in his backseat. Police arrive on the scene when a man threatens to shoot his wife.

programme.title: COPS: An Innocent Gardener
programme.desc: Officers pursue a vehicle that struck a police car. Two men deny the lawnmower in their truck was stolen. Deputies are called when a mother attempts to run her daughter over.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)
programme.desc: Marina Ciampi, 52, is found dead at her home in Marseille. The victim is naked on her bed, a plastic bag over her head. But no trace of a break-in is detected.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.

programme.title: The Hills' Abduction: The Zeta Reticuli Incident
programme.desc: Følg den fascinerende historie om Barney og Betty Hills bortførelse, der fik navnet Zeta Reticuli-hændelsen. Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: The Italian Ufologists
programme.desc: Italienske forskere udforsker ufo-observationer, virkelige vidnesbyrd og dykker ned i ufologiens historie og forskningsmetoder. Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: Alien Mass Sightings: The Undeniable Truth
programme.desc: En dokumentarfilm, der analyserer masseobservationer af rumvæsner. Den sætter spørgsmålstegn ved troværdigheden af de officielle forklaringer og identificerer fælles mønstre for yderligere undersøgelser. Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: Giant UFOs
programme.desc: On January 28, 1994, an Air France pilot, his crew and passengers witnessed a brightly-glowing red and brown disc-shaped object while flying to London.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Mor
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand opfører sig barnligt om det at skulle føde et barn. Fødselsveerne gør ham hjælpeløs, så Faredrengen og Piper må træde til for at stoppe et par fedtede fedttyve.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Synlige Brad
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen får brug for en lille smule magi og noget hjælp fra en gammel ven, hvis de vil fange en tyv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Historietank
programme.desc: Meget er på spil, da Henry påstår, at han ikke kan blive bange. Schwoz bruger en maskine, som virtuelt lader Henry opleve de uhyggelige historier, som alle i Mandehulen fortæller ham i et forsøg på at vise Henry, at han tager fejl.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Højtidstæsk
programme.desc: En ny art af møl æder alle juletræerne i Swellview, så Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen tager til Nabostrup for at købe nogle flere. På vejen hjem bliver de angrebet af nogle luskede træhandlere og må kæmpe for at redde julen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Misundelsesmuren
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen holder vagt ved Swellviews nyeste attraktion, Misundelsesmuren, da Kaptajn Mand ødelægger muren i et forsøg på at eliminere en lille fugl. Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand må nu finde en måde at erstatte den på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hr. Flinkofyr
programme.desc: En selvtægtsudøver iklædt en smiley-fjæs-maske straffer indbyggere i Swellview for uhøflig optræden. Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mands undersøgelser leder dem til et TV-studie ejet af den kendte børneprogramsvært hr. Wallabee.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Theranos sko
programme.desc: Henry og de andre ødelægger Rays elskede filmrekvisit, theranos-skoen. Nu må Henry og Jasper rejse til en mandehule i et alternativt univers ved hjælp af Bill Evils interdimensionelle transporter og stjæle deres theranos-sko, før Ray opdager det.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rumblr
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand, som er træt af altid at kæmpe mod de samme skurke, vil lave en profil på en app, som matcher helte og skurke. Faredrengen gør det samme, og nu sætter de to en dobbeltkamp op for at kæmpe mod nogle nye skurke.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En huledate
programme.desc: Henry og gutterne arrangerer en hemmelig undergrundsrestaurant i mandehulen i anledning af Charlottes middag med musiksuperstjernen Jack Swagger. Da rygtet om at Jack Swagger er i byen slipper ud, dukker der nogle uventede gæster op til festen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Telefonernes kamp
programme.desc: Da en ung pige lænker sig selv uden for Skidt og Kanel, tvinges Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand til at hjælpe med at finde hendes telefon. Under en overvågning render de uventet ind i nogle velkendte ansigter med en lusket plan.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Escape Room
programme.desc: Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand bliver luret ind i et escaperoom af en vred og forsmået fabriksejer. De er nu fanget derinde sammen med to nye børn, Mika og Miles, som er overraskende gode til at svare på de gåder, de skal løse for at blive lukket ud.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Mando Diao MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Med gæstekunstnere som Ane Brun, Kristofer Greczula og Veera Pyykkö indtager Mando Diao MTV Unplugged-scenen. Pluto TV byder på en intim koncert med Mando Diao og deres nye album "Efter Solnedgången"

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Lenny Kravitz unplugged.

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Nirvana's classic acoustic performance recorded at Sony Music Studios in New York City on November 18, 1993.

programme.title: John Mellencamp MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This one-hour episode with beloved American rocker John Mellencamp was taped in Los Angeles in April of 1992, and features a medley of Mellencamp hits, past and present.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This episode of Unplugged features Canadian star Alanis Morissette, shot from the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Workaholics: Checkpoint Gnarly
programme.desc: Alices bror kommer på forretningsrejse. Anders, Adam og Blake tager ham ud i byen en aften. Det går galt, når de bliver tjekket for sprutkørsel.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Strike
programme.desc: Anders, Adam og Blake beslutter, at de vil have en fridag for at fejre helligdagen 'halvt jul'. Når Alice nægter, strejker de.

programme.title: Workaholics: Muscle I'd Like to Flex
programme.desc: Fyrene øver sig på deres troldmands-rap til renæssaincemarkedet. Adam falder for en ældre kvinde, som han møder, mens han træner på kontorets tag. Anders og Blake føler sig uden for.

programme.title: Workaholics: In the Line of Getting Fired
programme.desc: Adam, Anders og Blake må kæmpe for deres job, når TelAmeriCorps direktør, Bruce Benson, beslutter at likvidere firmaet. Benson har en meget mærkelig anmodning.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Pete Holmes
programme.desc: Pete Holmes forklarer sine teorier om facebook og sine homoseksuelle tendenser.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Ryan Stout
programme.desc: Ryan Stout beskriver sin yndlingslatter og forklarer fordelene ved at være hjemløs.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Amy Schumer
programme.desc: Amy Schumer taler om, hvor smukke folk er i Miami (selv de hjemløse), håndtering af racisme som barn, og hvordan Facebook har afløst skæbnen.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Mike DeStefano
programme.desc: Mike DeStefano hjælper sorte med at praje taxier for dem, forklarer hvordan man er en professionel amerikaner og de gode ved stoffer i denne stand-up-special på en halv time.
